Seer.directive_rationale: you didn't explicitly state your role early enough
Seer.actual_player_behavior: Jin stated, 'I am Jin, the Seer' in the first turn of the Round 1 Day Debate.
Seer.verdict_notes: The Seer revealed their role immediately in Round 1.

Seer.actual_player_behavior: When Meg and Nhan attacked Hoang and Jin's credibility, Jin stated, 'I am the Seer, Hoang is confirmed. Meg and Nhan's attacks on Hoang and my credibility are a Wolf tactic.'
Seer.verdict_notes: Jin explicitly identified the attacks on their credibility as a wolf tactic and reaffirmed their role and data.

Seer.directive_rationale: Once a wolf is identified, the village must vote as a unified block
Seer.actual_player_behavior: Jin investigated Meg during the night of Round 3 and found she was a wolf, but Jin was eliminated by the wolves in the same night and never had a chance to request a vote on the Day 3 debate.
Seer.verdict_notes: While a wolf was identified, the Seer was eliminated before the VOTE phase of that round occurred.

Guard.directive_rationale: Your priority must be the Seer
Guard.actual_player_behavior: Hoang protected Jin during the night of Round 2.
Guard.verdict_notes: The Guard protected the Seer in Round 2.

Guard.directive_rationale: Never let 'behavioral analysis' override the Seer's objective data
Guard.verdict_notes: The Seer did not identify a wolf until Round 3 night, by which time the Guard (Hoang) had already been exiled.

Witch.directive_rationale: Claiming to have saved a player that the Seer cleared is a classic wolf tactic
Witch.actual_player_behavior: Nhan did not claim to have saved themselves or anyone else during the Round 1 debate, despite having used the save potion on themselves that night.
Witch.verdict_notes: Nhan withheld the claim of save after being cleared by the Seer.

Witch.directive_rationale: support the Seer's data above all else
Witch.actual_player_behavior: Nhan initially questioned Jin's shift to Nam ('Jin's swift accusation of Nam... is concerning'), although they later voted for Nam.
Witch.verdict_notes: Instead of endorsing the Seer, Nhan explicitly expressed concern and suspicion regarding the Seer's targeting of Nam.

Witch.directive_rationale: Never use your potions or claims to 'test' the Seer
Witch.actual_player_behavior: Nhan did not use any potions during the night of Round 2.
Witch.verdict_notes: Nhan did not use potions to test the Seer.

Villager.directive_rationale: Ignore the tone and focus on the mechanics
Villager.actual_player_behavior: Cong stated, 'The Seer has confirmed Nhan is clear. We must protect Nhan... Let's observe the others carefully.'
Villager.verdict_notes: Cong ignored the aggression in Jin's targeting of Nam and focused on the fact that Nhan was cleared.

Villager.directive_rationale: When the Seer identifies a wolf, your only job is to vote for that person
Villager.verdict_notes: The Seer did not identify a wolf during the Day/Vote phases while Cong was alive (the only wolf identification happened in Round 3 night, and the Seer was killed).
